lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa ke roop na jaahee lakhane kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||2||
lines.translation: His beauteous forms cannot be comprehended; what can anyone accomplish by discussing and debating? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teen gunaa tere jug hee a(n)tar chaare tereeaa khaanee ||
lines.translation: Throughout the ages, You are the three qualities, and the four sources of creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taa param pad paaeeai kathe akath kahaanee ||3||
lines.translation: If You show Your Mercy, then one obtains the supreme status, and speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) karataa keeaa sabh teraa kiaa ko kare paraanee ||
lines.translation: You are the Creator; all are created by You. What can any mortal being do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau nadar karahi too(n) apanee saaee sach samaanee ||4||
lines.translation: He alone, upon whom You shower Your Grace, is absorbed into the Truth. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam teraa sabh koee let hai jetee aavan jaanee ||
lines.translation: Everyone who comes and goes chants Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa guramukh boojhai hor manamukh phirai iaanee ||5||
lines.translation: When it is pleasing to Your Will, then the Gurmukh understands. Otherwise, the self-willed manmukhs wander in ignorance. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ved brahame kau deee paR paR kare veechaaree ||
lines.translation: You gave the four Vedas to Brahma, for him to read and read continually, and reflect upon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: taa kaa hukam na boojhai bapuRaa narak surag avataaree ||6||
lines.translation: The wretched one does not understand His Command, and is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jugah jugah ke raaje keee gaavahi kar avataaree ||
lines.translation: In each and every age, He creates the kings, who are sung of as His Incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tin bhee a(n)t na paaiaa taa kaa kiaa kar aakh veechaaree ||7||
lines.translation: Even they have not found His limits; what can I speak of and contemplate? ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sachaa teraa keeaa sabh saachaa dehi ta saach vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: You are True, and all that You do is True. If You bless me with the Truth, I will speak on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau sach bujhaavahi apanaa sahaje naam samaanee ||8||1||23||
lines.translation: One whom You inspire to understand the Truth, is easily absorbed into the Naam. ||8||1||23||
Aasaa, Third Mehl:
The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.
He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.
Focusing on the Word of the Shabad, I have obtained lasting peace. ||1||
Listen, O my mind, to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: devan vaalaa sabh bidh jaanai guramukh paaeeai naam nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver knows our condition completely; the Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The great glory of meeting the True Guru is
that it has quenched the fire of possessiveness and desire;
imbued with peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin gur poore koi na jaanee ||
lines.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.
Attached to Maya, they are engrossed in duality.
The Gurmukh receives the Naam, and the Bani of the Lord's Word. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa tapaa(n) sir tap saar ||
lines.translation: Service to the Guru is the most excellent and sublime penance of penances.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu man vasai sabh dookh visaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.
Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te tribhavan sojhee hoi ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, one comes to know the three worlds.
Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.
Through the True Word of His Bani, we enter the Mansion of His Presence. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sabh kul udhaare ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, all of one's generations are saved.
Keep the Immaculate Naam enshrined within your heart.
In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be adorned with True Glory. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee j gur sevaa laae ||
lines.translation: How very fortunate are they, who are committed to the Guru's service.
Night and day, they are engaged in devotional worship; the True Name is implanted within them.
Through the Naam, all of one's generations are saved. ||7||
Nanak chants the true thought.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.
Imbued with devotion to the Lord, the gate of salvation is found. ||8||2||24||
Aasaa, Third Mehl:
Everyone lives, hoping in hope.
Understanding His Command, one becomes free of desire.
So many are asleep in hope.
He alone wakes up, whom the Lord awakens. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur naam bujhaaiaa vin naavai bhukh na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has led me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Naam, hunger does not go away.
